info.title: api.spring.io
info.description: Spring's own project metadata, keyless (HAL JSON). Generations are the support lines: when each release line's open-source and commercial support ends. Releases are the versions the Spring website currently lists, not the full history.

get.summary: A Spring project's release lines and their support end dates
get.description: `_embedded.generations[]`: `{name: '3.5.x', initialReleaseDate, ossSupportEndDate, commercialSupportEndDate, support}`. `project` is the site's slug: spring-boot, spring-framework, spring-security, spring-data, spring-cloud, spring-batch, spring-integration, spring-kafka, spring-amqp, spring-session, spring-authorization-server, spring-ai, spring-graphql, spring-modulith, spring-shell, spring-vault, spring-ws, spring-hateoas, spring-restdocs.

get.summary: The versions a Spring project's site currently lists
get.description: `_embedded.releases[]`: `{version, status: GENERAL_AVAILABILITY|PRERELEASE|SNAPSHOT, current, referenceDocUrl, apiDocUrl}` — the handful of versions on the project page, `current` marking the one it recommends.
